say:1:1430318201:1.text: Do you know him? He used be wander around here all the time, complaining about his ultimate demise.
say:1:1430318201:1.source_cn: 你认识他？他之前经常在这，总是担心自己发生孽化。
say:1:1430318201:1.male: Do you know him? He used be wander around here all the time, complaining about his ultimate demise.
say:1:1430318201:1.female: Do you know him? He used be wander around here all the time, complaining about his ultimate demise.

say:2:1430318202:1.text: Who would've thought that in the end, it was his parents who became corrupted instead of him?
say:2:1430318202:1.source_cn: 谁能想到最终孽化的不是他，而是他的父母。

say:3:1430318203:1.text: He snapped after he witnessed their demise with his very eyes.
say:3:1430318203:1.source_cn: 而他因为亲眼目睹了这一切，彻底疯掉了。
